thread:
maria_cs: FYI — AcmePayments filed an escalation: after yesterday's v2-optim rollout their checkout assistant is returning order totals that are systematically rounded down (e.g. $19.99 -> $19.00). They attached 3 customer examples and said it started ~14:10 UTC. Can we repro?

eli_repro: ack. can you paste one of their minimal prompts + the exact output they got? also need the request_id(s) or timestamps from their side so we can correlate logs.

maria_cs: pasted one inline (sanitized):

Customer prompt:
```
SYSTEM: You are a checkout assistant. Sum the item prices and return a JSON {"subtotal":..., "tax":..., "total":...}
USER: items: [{"name":"notebook","price":9.99},{"name":"pen","price":4.50},{"name":"sticker","price":5.50}]
INSTRUCTION: return numbers with two decimals
```

Customer got back:
```
{"subtotal":19.0,"tax":1.0,"total":20.0}
```

maria_cs: they said model used was `redwood/v2-optim` (no custom system prompts on their side). They did not stream. Temp=0.0, max_tokens=32.

jordan_se: thanks. first quick checks: possible causes = tokenization/formatter change, model prompt-conditioning shift, post-processing step trimming decimals, or a quantization/math-bug in v2-optim runtime.

eli_repro: can we get the request logs for that customer timestamp? maria, ask them to run: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/requests/logs?request_id=<their_request_id>
```
and redact any PII. we specifically need: model, model_version, request_id, prompt (full), response raw (token-level if available), and the inference backend id (node id).

maria_cs: asked Acme to supply request_ids and raw responses. they replied with 2 ids but no token-level dump yet. forwarded.

liz_ops: if we can't repro on hosted, we should also confirm whether this rollout touched a kernel selection or quantization profile for the cheapest runtime. i'll check the rollout notes.

deploy-bot: rollouts: v2-optim promoted to stable @2026-03-12T13:45:02Z; changed kernel profile: fp16->q4_0 in fallback path for some sequences.

eli_repro: that q4 note is suspicious. quantized math for decimals can misrepresent floating rounding in edge cases. but a rounding to whole dollars seems like a post-processing/formatting issue too. jordan, can you run a quick local repro against v1-stable and v2-optim with the sanitized prompt? use deterministic settings (temp=0, top_p=1, streaming=false). here's a recommended curl for repro: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_DEBUG_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/v2-optim","input":"SYSTEM: You are a checkout assistant...","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":32,"log_level":"debug"}'
```

jordan_se: running now. will attach raw token log and model backend id.

(jordan_se posts results a few minutes later)
jordan_se: v2-optim raw output token stream: `[{token: 123, text: '{"subtotal":19', ...}, {token: 45, text: '.0', ...}, ...]` -> I can reproduce the truncated decimals on my account when running against the q4 backend id `node-88a` but NOT when I force run on `node-12b` which uses the fp16 path.

eli_repro: good catch. that strongly implicates the quantized runtime path. maria, ask Acme if their requests were routed through any capacity tags (region/economy tier) that would select q4 backends — if they had reserved capacity they might be on a different pool.

maria_cs: asked. they said they are on hosted free-tier (so economy routing). confirmed their request_ids match node-88a in logs.

liz_ops: I can open a rollback on the kernel profile for economy pool to restore fp16 for the sequence lengths involved. however need product approval for emergency rollback.

deploy-bot: incident ticket created: #INC-4521 (quantization-decimal-regression). assigned to infra/release.

eli_repro: meanwhile, we still need a minimal repro we can share with infra: one-shot prompt that reproduces reliably. jordan, can you shorten prompt to the absolute minimal that still triggers it? also include the exact model header we used.

jordan_se: minimal repro I found: 
```
Input: "You are a payment assistant. Sum: [9.99,4.50,5.50]. Return JSON with two decimals."
Model: redwood/v2-optim
Temp: 0
max_tokens: 24
Backend observed: node-88a (q4)
Observed: subtotal -> 19.0 (missing .99/.50 decimals)
```

Reproduces 9/10 on node-88a, 0/50 on node-12b.

eli_repro: perfect. i'm going to tag infra + release for a hotfix. maria, share the minimal repro with the customer and offer a temporary mitigation: pin model to `redwood/v1-stable` or set routing to dedicated/reserved (if they can) until we fix. also offer to run their requests through a quick post-processor (server-side) to format floats correctly as a stopgap.

maria_cs: sent workaround + asked if they'd like us to pin them back to v1 while we investigate. they accepted pin to v1 for now, want ETA.

liz_ops: i'll propose rollback to product. if approved, ops can revert kernel profile for economy nodes within ~50 minutes.

deploy-bot: incident ticket created: #INC-4521 (quantization-decimal-regression). assigned to infra/release.

eli_repro: thanks everyone. action items:
- jord an: attach minimal repro + token-level dump to INC-4521 (done)
- liz_ops: request product approval for economy kernel rollback (in flight)
- maria_cs: confirm customer pinned to v1 and send thanks + temporary mitigation details
- infra: root cause verification on q4 math ops + unit test to catch decimal formatting regressions

maria_cs: customer pinned to v1, appreciates quick response. closing loop with them and will update thread once rollback ETA is final. :thumbsup:
